description: Protect what you’ve been entrusted with. #stewardship #boundaries #intentionalliving
transcript: Be mindful of how much access you give and how much access you take. Being a good steward of your life looks like protecting other people's boundaries as well. It is not just about us. You do not need unlimited access to everything, and not everything requires unlimited access to you. Coming a strong steward of your life looks like looking at the external world while simultaneously looking at your internal world. Looking through life with the lens of wisdom, respect and intention.
